boundary: Actual React components and stylesheet in Chromium with deterministic intercepted HTTP and a stub popup. No real authentication, Cloudflare, OAuth account, OpenConnector service, provider action, model, Slack or external execution.
checks: Workspace branch mounts with zero personal integration/setup/mailbox API calls
Catalog keyboard focus wraps in both directions; Escape restores opener
Explicit audience checkbox is required before the isolated fixture sign-in popup opens
Popup return reconciles exact pending receipt/version/fingerprint with workspace header
Account configuration, upstream authorization, unknown action health and explicit grants remain distinct
Manager explicitly grants exact employee version and member grant version; Finance label does not confer authority
Member sees only fixture-granted account and cannot manage consent, grants or personal setup
Member requests exact registered action/arguments without execution or self-approval
Manager approval records a decision and cannot execute as a different requester
Original member requester explicitly executes exactly once in fixture; no model or provider endpoint is contacted
Unknown execution outcome blocks new requests and execution retries
Lost execute response blocks both approved cards and new work on the account until explicit terminal reconciliation
Held workspace A consent response cannot navigate or reconcile a retained popup in workspace B
390px accounts and grant editor have no horizontal document overflow
Denied scoped catalog access closes the dialog and clears cached accounts and action data
Revocation removes cached account, grants and action results without personal fallback
No unexpected API, external network, browser console or page errors
Reviewed frontend and shared wire sources remained frozen throughout Chromium test
expectedNetworkFailures: Fixture execute response deliberately lost after committed receipt
